gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that an empty SimpleBloomFilter does not report containing bits drawn from an external BitMapExtractor.
ADDED i2: Construct a BitMapExtractor whose first 64-bit word has value 2490, meaning several low-order bits are set in that word.
ADDED i3: An empty filter has no bits set, so it cannot contain the extractor's bits.
